+    def _focal_localization(self, kind, msg, info):
+        # Temporary bounded source observations. Never a motion/health witness.
+        try:
+            import base64
+            from rclpy.serialization import serialize_message
+            loc = self.motion_samples['localization']
+            counts = loc['message_counts']
+            counts[kind] = counts.get(kind, 0) + 1
+            now = self.get_clock().now().nanoseconds
+            header = getattr(msg, 'header', None)
+            entry = {'received_ros_ns': now, 'received_monotonic_s': time.monotonic(),
+                     'header_stamp_ns': (header.stamp.sec * 1_000_000_000 +
+                         header.stamp.nanosec) if header is not None else None,
+                     'frame': header.frame_id if header is not None else None}
+            for field in ('source_timestamp', 'received_timestamp',
+                          'publication_sequence_number', 'reception_sequence_number'):
+                entry['dds_' + field] = (info.get(field) if isinstance(info, dict)
+                                        else getattr(info, field, None))
+            if kind in ('tf', 'tf_static'):
+                entry['transforms'] = [
+                    {'parent': tr.header.frame_id, 'child': tr.child_frame_id,
+                     'stamp_ns': tr.header.stamp.sec * 1_000_000_000 + tr.header.stamp.nanosec,
+                     'xyz': [tr.transform.translation.x, tr.transform.translation.y,
+                             tr.transform.translation.z],
+                     'quaternion': [tr.transform.rotation.x, tr.transform.rotation.y,
+                                    tr.transform.rotation.z, tr.transform.rotation.w]}
+                    for tr in msg.transforms[:32]]
+                entry['truncated'] = len(msg.transforms) > 32
+            elif kind == 'scan':
+                entry['serialized_ros_base64'] = base64.b64encode(serialize_message(msg)).decode()
+                entry['ranges_count'] = len(msg.ranges)
+            else:
+                pose = msg.pose if kind == 'truth' else msg.pose.pose
+                entry['xyz'] = [pose.position.x, pose.position.y, pose.position.z]
+                entry['quaternion'] = [pose.orientation.x, pose.orientation.y,
+                                       pose.orientation.z, pose.orientation.w]
+                if kind == 'amcl':
+                    entry['covariance'] = list(msg.pose.covariance)
+                elif kind in ('odom', 'odom_truth'):
+                    entry['child_frame'] = msg.child_frame_id
+                    entry['twist'] = [msg.twist.twist.linear.x, msg.twist.twist.linear.y,
+                                      msg.twist.twist.linear.z, msg.twist.twist.angular.x,
+                                      msg.twist.twist.angular.y, msg.twist.twist.angular.z]
+            capacity = {'tf': 2048, 'tf_static': 16, 'scan': 128, 'amcl': 128,
+                        'truth': 768, 'odom': 768, 'odom_truth': 768}[kind]
+            history = loc[kind]

+            if (kind == 'amcl' and self._focal_loc_future is None
